My primary professional identity is as a mathematics teacher. I love teaching mathematics and related subjects, and I love helping my students grow.

I maintain a modest research agenda, studying geometric analysis and partial differential equations, and their applications to mathematical general relativity.

When not teaching or doing mathematics, I enjoy being outdoors — hiking, paddling, gardening, and cross-country skiing.
